description: Four switches on one panel: each passes its input to its output while the CV it is compared against stays at or below the voltage its knob sets

params.text: Sets the threshold for that channel, -10V to 10V; the channel passes while its CV is at or below this and blocks while the CV is above it

inputs.text: The signal channel 2 passes; with nothing patched it takes IN1
The signal channel 3 passes; with nothing patched it takes IN2
The signal channel 4 passes; with nothing patched it takes IN3
Compared against the knobs of channels 1 and 2, and against the knobs of channels 3 and 4 as well whenever the other CV jack is empty
Compared against the knobs of channels 3 and 4; with nothing patched it takes the voltage at the other CV jack

outputs.text: That channel's input while its CV is at or below its knob, and 0V while the CV is above it
The four channel outputs added together and divided by four

notes: every knob comes up at 0V and an empty CV jack reads 0V, so all four channels are passing at startup: zero is at or below zero.
the four inputs are normalled down the row and the two CV jacks left to right, so one signal in IN1 and one CV in the left CV jack works all four channels.

unpatched it reads IN1.
